evidence.reason: Changed plan argument from "monthly" to "benchmark" and removed metering.initialize(), altering behavior relied on by test/metering.test.mjs which asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0 and subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.

Deleted entirely; tests reference usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount and historySize(), and the relationship indicates chargeUnit is shared with subscriptionCharge, so removal may break callers and history side effects.

Referenced by both subscriptionCharge and usageCharge per the relationship; deleting usageCharge while subscriptionCharge still divides by chargeUnit leaves the shared dependency path partially intact but the removed consumer's behavior is unverified.

result.userExplanation: 左改动把订阅计费的计费方案从 monthly 改成 benchmark 并去掉了初始化，右改动又删除了 usageCharge，二者合并后可能破坏测试和调用方依赖的月度计费与历史记录行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 恢复 metering.initialize() 并将 "benchmark" 改回 "monthly"；同时请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的删除方确认无调用方依赖后再移除，否则应恢复该函数。
